contact: Web form https://www.bnf.fr/fr/contacter-la-bnf — choose 'Objet du message: Reproduction de documents' (form routes to reproduction@bnf.fr)
notes: Form and subject verified on bnf.fr. BnF policy (bnf.fr press kit 2019, CP_politique_diffusion_images_BnF.pdf): images free for non-commercial use with source credit. Gallica terms page returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch, so the current wording of the Gallica conditions and the address utilisation.commerciale@bnf.fr (seen only in search snippets; it is for commercial/HD requests) are NOT verified.

institution: Biblioteca Nacional de España (BNE Digital, formerly BDH)
contact: not found (bne.es blocked automated access; candidates in notes are unverified)
notes: bne.es returned HTTP 403 to automated fetches. Search snippets of bne.es pages mention bibliotecadigital@bne.es (BNE Digital questions) and info.repro@bne.es (reproduction service) — owner must confirm on bne.es before use. Same snippets state BNE Digital PD works may be used publicly without prior authorisation, citing BNE as source.
Published in the Archive's own 2017 guide on toledo.es (reproduction requests may be made by e-mail). Guide is from 2017; a current toledo.es page was not checked.

Fee table (Nov 2024) says publication/exhibition use needs permission from the Archives and Collections Director via a publication permission form (price on application); curators@ is the published collections enquiry address in that document (given in the loans paragraph). Alternative: archives@jerseyheritage.org (Jersey Archive, https://www.jerseyheritage.org/contact/). Catalogue record pages returned 403 to automated fetch.

notes: General office address of the museum. The page also lists a 'Rinkinių apskaitos ir skaitmeninimo skyrius' (collections accounting & digitisation) with staff addresses; the letter asks the office to forward it. Only 3 items.

institution: Bibliotheca Hertziana – Max Planck Institute for Art History, Photographic Collection
notes: Official inquiries address of the Photographic Collection; publication orders use a PDF form sent to the same address. 40 plates referenced from only 2 album-level records (obj08003573, obj08003574).
Published on the library page in obfuscated form (la.bibliotheque..åt..observatoiredeparis.psl.eu); read via WebFetch, not visible to plain HTML scraping. Items already CC BY-NC.

institution: BIU Santé (Université Paris Cité) — banque d'images
notes: 'Poser une question' librarian form (reply within 72 working hours). No dedicated image-rights e-mail found. Press (Livres Hebdo) reports BIU Santé put its PD digital documents under Licence Ouverte — not verified on an official page; the letter asks them to state the conditions.

contact: not verified — candidates: image.licensing@metmuseum.org (Terms and Conditions page) and Image Request Form http://www.metmuseum.org/research/image-resources/image-request-form (routes to Art Resource)

institution: Library of Congress, Prints & Photographs Division
notes: Thank-you + IIIF question. Works are embeddable already ('No known restrictions on publication'). IIIF Image Services documented at https://www.loc.gov/apis/micro-services/image-services/ .
items_note: 5 direct LoC records (open) + 10 Commons files citing LoC

notes: info@ is listed for 'Questions related to Wikipedia or other wikis' and is answered by volunteers. COM:HOTLINK (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Commons:Reusing_content_outside_Wikimedia/technical) already states hotlinking is allowed but not recommended and downloading is recommended — the owner may not need to send this at all.
